currentWork.title: FINAL.31 highway-candidate preference — production released and verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.31 is live. PR #160 merged to main at 00d8f0398680af4411a59fe393ceb43b5671a766. Vercel production dpl_2N4u6GfxFjYzg8ewB5zFLRgDvTJm is READY. Main browser regression run 37536656828 and GitHub Pages run 37536654747 passed. Live version.json and public truck-routing.js report FINAL.31.
rootCause: FINAL.30 highway ON only allowed expressways; it still accepted the single ORS fastest route when that route stayed entirely on surface roads.
The operator expectation is stronger: highway ON should prefer a route that actually contains motorway/tollway evidence when such a candidate exists.
scope: Highway ON requests up to 3 ORS alternative HGV routes.
Selection order is motorway candidate, then tollway-only candidate, then normal optimal fallback only when no highway/toll candidate exists.
Same-priority candidates are ordered by duration then distance.
Highway OFF remains strict with no alternatives and avoids highways+tollways+ferries.
FINAL.30 MAP toggle/persistence, FINAL.29 classification/colors, fullscreen PIN behavior, HGV dimensions/weight, Analytics, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain preserved.
